title: Universal Lichnerowicz Lifting of Near-Horizon Soft Modes
summary: A recurring universality appears in the low-temperature quantum thermodynamics of near-extremal black holes, where distinct parent geometries often lead to the same logarithmic temperature dependence at one loop. In this work, we study the Lichnerowicz spectral origin of this infrared universality and understand why the relevant spectral data become insensitive to the details of the parent geometry.
